meta.name: design-first
meta.description: Guide structured design thinking through 5 progressive levels before any code is written. Levels: Capabilities, Components, Interactions, Contracts, Implementation. Use when building new features, refactoring significant code, designing modules, or when the user says 'design this', 'architect this', 'let's think before coding', 'walk me through the design', or 'whiteboard this'. For simple utilities or single-component tasks, enter at Level 4 (Contracts). Do not use for quick bug patches.

copy.tagline: 在写代码前用5个层次引导结构化设计思考
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在编码前系统化地设计软件架构。
copy.tagline_en: Guide structured design thinking through 5 progressive levels before coding
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to systematically design software architecture before writing code.
